purpose: Document city-local registry evidence and bounded public parcel-geometry route review.
assessment: The WUP point is a settlement centroid, not a parcel identity. ESA’s official Damietta cooperation material covers surveying and digitizing state-owned land records at governorate scope; a 2025 project also shows the local survey directorate produces official maps. Neither source proves anonymous, complete, private-parcel geometry at the WUP point. ESA digital maps are request-based; no geometry request was made. No owner/address or identity data retained.
registryAssessment: The Egyptian Survey Authority (ESA) identifies its Damietta Survey Directorate and an ESA–Damietta Governorate cooperation protocol for surveying and digitizing the governorate’s state-land inventory. This establishes a local surveying/maps institution and a city/gubernatorial land-record project, but not a public parcel service for the WUP point, private-title registry access, or anonymous full geometry.

officialPrimarySources.observation: First-party Egyptian Survey Authority report names the Governor of Damietta and the Director of the Damietta Survey Directorate in a protocol for a comprehensive land inventory, precise surveying and digitization of state-owned lands in Damietta Governorate. The project is for state lands, not evidence of open private parcel coverage.

Official ESA overview describes its surveying, map-production and property-record mapping mandate and map services; general national mandate alone does not establish parcel coverage at Damietta’s WUP point.
Official ESA digital-map service description is a request-based map-product path; no anonymous vector geometry endpoint is described.
